title: Death Certification and Mortuary Release Procedure
content: Death of a patient must be certified by the treating physician and documented in the HIS Clinical Module within 1 hour of the event. The Cause of Death Certificate must be completed using the correct ICD-10 cause and immediate/underlying cause fields; all deaths within 24 hours of admission or under anesthesia require Medical Superintendent review. The family must be notified of the death by the attending physician personally; a nursing staff member must provide emotional support and bereavement information. The body may be released to the family after: death certification, clearance of the final bill, and submission of the Mortuary Release Form (Form DIS-MORT-01) signed by a next-of-kin with valid ID. Cases of unnatural death, accidents, or medicolegal cases must be reported to the police before release; legal clearance is mandatory. Autopsy requests (hospital-initiated or family-requested) must be documented and handled per the Post-Mortem Policy.
